note: Coalition platforms for PRN Johor 2026, faithfully summarised from published manifestos / credible reporting. PN remains pending — no full manifesto released.

PH.title: Johor Untuk Semua ~ 10-point manifesto
pledges: 250,000 new high-paying jobs; raise median wage 30%
80,000 affordable homes in five years
First-home deposit aid up to RM8,000; rent-to-own scheme
Johor Health Scheme covering up to RM100,000 yearly
RM1 billion SME fund; RM500 million Johor Youth Fund
RM50 monthly transport pass; RM1,000 per newborn
Gigabit internet and AI labs in all schools by 2030
Halve Malaysia–Singapore checkpoint waits by integrating RTS Link, ETS, Bas.My and smart mobility systems

BN.title: TEKAD BN Johor ~ 63 pledges, 6 pillars
pledges: 200,000 jobs, incl. 100,000 premium-income for Johoreans
RM100 million fund for subsidised home ownership
RM100 million Johor Youth Education Fund
Strengthen Bantuan Kasih Johor cash aid, better targeted
Housing rental deposit scheme for young people
Continue first-home and housing rental assistance
Semarak Isya' programme in every state constituency
Boost SME participation in strategic supply chains

PN.note: As of 10 Jul 2026, PN had not published a formal multi-point manifesto comparable to PH/BN for PRN Johor 2026. Campaign messaging focused on leadership and seat-level canvassing rather than a single state manifesto. This block stays pending rather than inventing pledges.

BERSAMA.title: Aku Janji Khidmat ~ 5 service pledges
BERSAMA.note: BERSAMA (Rafizi Ramli's new party) contested 15 seats and offered signed service pledges rather than a full manifesto.
pledges: Monthly mobile complaint counters, a digital platform and public forums
Serve as a constructive opposition that proposes solutions, not just criticism
Defend homeownership and protect traditional and heritage villages from over-development
Push an integrated bus network with first and last-mile links in JB
Strengthen checks and balances: watch state finances and curb leakage

MUDA-PSM.title: Progressive Bloc ~ MUDA & PSM
MUDA-PSM.note: MUDA and PSM contested as an alliance with separate platforms, not one combined manifesto.
pledges: MUDA: abolish the law allowing up to 5 appointed, unelected assembly members
PSM: affordable housing with rent control pegged to household income
PSM: transit and starter homes for young families
PSM: create enough jobs for the roughly 200,000 youths who graduate yearly
PSM: tighter environmental rules for factories and data centres; keep rivers clean
PSM: balanced north and south development, with more jobs in northern Johor
